fees.note: CampLife quote for Tue 6 - Wed 7 July 2027, one night, 2 adults: $28.84 on every site sampled, with or without electric (30A, first come first served); the estimate isn't itemized. A 3-night minimum applies over Memorial Day, the Fourth of July and Labor Day.

source: https://www.camplife.com/1378/reservation/step1 (CampLife quote read 2026-10-11: 14 of 42 sites free on 2027-07-06, each $28.84 for one night)

fees.note: Port of Port Townsend 2026 rate schedule: summer (May 1 - Sep 30) partial hookup $60, hookup $68, premium waterfront $80; winter (Oct 1 - Apr 30) $45 / $53 / $62; holidays +10% (the holiday, 2 days before and 1 after). Reservation fee $11.81; sales tax extra and a 3% card processing fee. CampLife's own quotes for Tue 10 Nov 2026 came to $58.67-73.14 before tax (not itemized).
CampLife quote for Tue 13 - Wed 14 Oct 2026, one night, 2 adults: standard full-hookup sites $43.50-57.50, the pull-through site $78.50; tax isn't itemized. July 2027 dates weren't bookable yet.

source: https://www.camplife.com/253/reservation/step1 (CampLife quotes read 2026-10-11 for 2026-10-13: 55 sites free, 11 sampled)

fees.note: Campspot quote for Tue 6 - Wed 7 July 2027, 2 adults: electric and water RV site $53 a night (36 of 36 free, rigs to 50 ft). The park books online as Pierz Golf Course and Campground.
Campspot quote for Tue 13 - Wed 14 Oct 2026, 2 adults: standard RV site C$42 (none free that night), riverfront RV site C$47 (rigs to 35 ft); tent and pop-up sites C$37-45.

Rock Island County Forest Preserve WebTrac fees: White Oak water/electric sites $24 for county residents and $27 for non-residents, Deer Haven full-hookup pull-throughs $27 / $30. Reserving is optional, but a reservation needs 2 nights.

source: https://ilrockislandcfpweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?display=detail&module=RN&interfaceparameter=webtrac (WebTrac rental search and item details read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: San Luis Obispo County WebTrac: every Oceano site lists 'Weekday Off-Season $61.00' and a $12 reservation fee; weekend and peak-season rates aren't shown. Holiday minimums of 2-3 nights; reservations open 180 days ahead.
Park With Us quote for Tue 10 - Wed 11 Nov 2026, 23-ft rig, 2 adults: A-row full-hookup sites $65 a night (26 free), premium P-row sites $75 (4); tax isn't shown before checkout.
Park With Us quote for Tue 6 - Wed 7 July 2027, 23-ft travel trailer: 30A sites $40 a night (water, most with sewer, 25-35 ft pads), 30/50A full-hookup sites $50 (60 ft).
RoverPass Instant Book quote for Tue 6 - Wed 7 July 2027: water and electric RV sites $20 a night (rigs to 45 ft), full hookup $25 (50 ft); 37 sites free.

Cultus Lake Park's Sunnyside Campground bylaw (effective 2026-07-29), full hook-up (30A) sites before tax: low season (until the third Friday in June and after Labour Day) Sun-Thu C$61.90, Fri-Sat C$63.80, long weekends C$78.10; high season C$68.55 / C$83.80 / C$88.55. Reservation fee C$26.67 a site plus a C$1.90 online booking fee. 2-night minimum on weekends, 3 on long weekends.

Sauk County's FareHarbor booking: non-electric RV sites $20 a night, electric (20/30A, a few 50A) $25, and each booking costs $5 more than its nights (2 nights $45 / $55). Online bookings start at 2 nights.

source: https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/whitemound/items/ (sites 01E and 42 priced for October 2026 dates; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: Letcher County's FlyBook booking page: RV slips $25 a night for up to 6 people; its $20 water/electric primitive spots are too small for a full-size camper.

Coos County reservationfriend search for Tue 10 - Thu 12 Nov 2026, 23-ft travel trailer: 20 standard water/electric (20/30A) sites at $23 a night. Reservations need 2 nights, open 270 days ahead, and aren't taken same-day; same-day arrivals find a site and pay the camp host.
San Joaquin County ActiveCommunities fee details for the Westgate campsites: $25 a day for the general public and a $10 processing fee per reservation; extra vehicle $5-12 a day, pets $1-4.

Don Pedro Recreation Agency search for Tue 10 - Thu 12 Nov 2026 (online bookings start at 2 nights): non-hookup sites $80 and full-hookup sites $120 for the 2 nights, i.e. $40 and $60 a night; 'other fees & taxes may apply'.

Nevada Irrigation District 2026 rates for Orchard Springs: full hook-up RV site $87 a night (its $57 and $68 sites are tent-only); reservation fee $12 a site; extra vehicle $22 a night. Reservations by phone.
